dataset.name: UK Multi-role Application Demo
dataset.description: Fully synthetic UK vacancies spanning software, administration, finance and project support for non-production release-candidate validation.

additionalJobs.title: Administrative Assistant
additionalJobs.description: A fictional community organisation needs an administrative assistant to coordinate diaries, prepare accurate records and respond helpfully to routine enquiries. This wholly synthetic vacancy values organisation, Microsoft Office confidence, careful written communication and dependable teamwork.

additionalJobs.title: Accounts Assistant
additionalJobs.description: A fictional housing team is recruiting an accounts assistant to process invoices, reconcile supplier statements and help answer account queries. This entirely synthetic vacancy values bookkeeping fundamentals, payroll awareness, Excel accuracy, Xero experience and clear customer communication.

additionalJobs.title: Project Coordinator
additionalJobs.description: A fictional education partnership needs a project coordinator to maintain delivery plans, track risks and budgets, prepare governance updates and coordinate suppliers. This fully synthetic role values structured reporting, stakeholder communication, workshop support and continuous improvement.

additionalJobs.title: Programme Support Officer
additionalJobs.description: A fictional skills programme is seeking a programme support officer who can also perform project coordinator duties: organise workshops, maintain progress records, identify delivery risks and communicate with varied stakeholders. This synthetic vacancy welcomes transferable education and facilitation experience.

additionalJobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
additionalJobs.description: A fictional reliability product team needs a senior software engineer to lead Java and Spring Boot service improvements, strengthen contract tests and observability, mentor engineers and shorten dependable deployment lead times. This wholly synthetic Manchester role values pragmatic technical leadership and measurable service reliability.

additionalJobs.title: Platform Architect
additionalJobs.description: A fictional regulated-services organisation is seeking a platform architect to guide architecture across twelve services, facilitate technical decisions and establish governance and reliability controls. This entirely synthetic London vacancy values senior stakeholder leadership, incident reduction and evidence-based platform strategy.
